decisive_items: Symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques on the cheeks and temples
Positive: anti-Smith antibodies, SSA/Ro antibodies, SSB/La antibodies, and anti-U1RNP antibodies
response.rationale: Subacute Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus is more likely due to the presence of specific autoantibodies and characteristic skin lesions

rejected.why: Lack of specific autoantibodies and less characteristic skin lesions
